messages:
Noah: Tiny idea 1 11 let's do a '12 snacks of holiday cheer' thread. Each day someone posts a favorite snack + a micro-kudos to a teammate. No pressure, just vibes. :cookie:
Keiko: Love that. I'll start Day 1: candied nuts + kudos to @Noah for rescuing the release notes last sprint.
Omar: Day 2: peppermint bark + kudos to @Keiko for the onboarding doc updates. Also GIF incoming.
Tess: Day 3: hot cider packets in the pantry (help yourself) + kudos to @Omar for pair-debugging my flaky test.
PantryBot: FYI: Pantry restock scheduled 2pm tomorrow. Please mark open containers. :package:
Noah: Day 4: mini gingerbread cookies. Quick poll: should we do a tiny office secret recipe exchange?
Keiko: Yes please. Also posting a meme: "When the model outputs 'Merry Query-mas'" small santa machine GIF. :laughing:
Omar: Meme gold. Day 5: dark chocolate squares + kudos to @Tess for shepherding the privacy checklist.
Tess: Thank you! Day 6: oatmeal raisin (controversial) + shoutout to @Noah for triaging that storage issue on Friday night.
Noah: Note: if you have allergies, please sign the sticky on the pantry door. We'll keep separate trays.
Keiko: Day 7: spiced tea bags + quick office logistics q: anyone up for a 15-min holiday karaoke after demo day?
Omar: In. I demand a duet with someone who knows the 90s classics.
Tess: I will do backup vocals. Also Day 8: cocoa bombs in the freezer (heat instructions posted) + kudos to @Keiko for being the calm meeting chair.
PantryBot: Reminder: label allergens and dispose of opened perishables after seven days. :framed_picture:
Noah: Day 9: salted caramel bites. Tiny shoutout to @Omar for the weekend on-call coverage.
Keiko: Day 10: matcha biscuits + I'm dropping a small paper card with a handwritten note for my kudos recipient tomorrow. Feels old-school but sweet.
Omar: Day 11: chocolate-covered espresso beans (for those late-night debugging sprints) + kudos to the infra team for smoothing out the staging cluster.
Tess: Day 12: mini fruitcake (I promise it's good) + big kudos to everyone for getting through Q4. Also: karaoke after demo day is a go. I'll bring a portable speaker.
Noah: Finale: group selfie at the end of the karaoke and a silly collage in #general. Thanks for indulging my snack nerdery. Happy holidays everyone :tada:
PantryBot: Stats: 12 snack posts, 12 kudos. :bar_chart:
